proof_payload.boundary: ERC-8274 recompute/cross-reference-console — claim_id independently re-derived from the live source with reference/claim_id.py and checked against the registered ClaimPreimage; decision_ref taken as-is from the source rather than re-derived from its own sub-preimage. Not run inside the gateway container, so dependency_lock, runtime_image and execution_witness are honestly null rather than carried over. First Cell on this claim: this opens the edge, it does not close one. Envelope validity is outside this boundary and is established by EIP-712 signer recovery against the registered address.

recomputed.decision_ref_from: record.verdict.decision_ref in the live source, taken as-is

evidence.cross_check: First Cell on this claim — no other node has published one yet, so this opens the edge rather than closing it. Note claim_preimage.artifact_type is 'review_verdict' (what the CLAIM is) while the source's verdict.artifact_type describes what the verdict is ABOUT; they are different layers and must not be reconciled by copying, which would change claim_id. Input content_hash is provenance of this fetch only: the source carries relay_anchor.checked_at, refreshed server-side.

verify: gate the claim_preimage; recompute claim_id; recompute evidence_hash=keccak256(JCS(evidence)); recover the signer and check it equals signature.signer AND proof_payload.verifier AND the address registered in nodes.json (quadruple equality, CELL-v1.md §2); check registry_id equals this registry (CELL-v2.md §2); re-run the evidence yourself.
